prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the channels you need (SEO, paid ads, social, content, product marketing, web design, etc.).

To give a targeted recommendation I need a few details:
- What are your primary goals? (lead gen, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (SEO, PPC, social, content, creative, analytics, growth marketing, site build)
- Budget range (monthly retainer or project budget)?
- Company stage and size (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Industry or target audience?
- Do you require an agency physically in San Francisco or are remote/onshore OK?

If you want a quick checklist for evaluating agencies now, look for:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for clients like you
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence
- Transparent pricing and team composition (who will do the work)
- Industry experience and references you can contact
- Service specialization vs. “jack of all trades” (match to your needs)
- Contract flexibility and ramp timeline
- Cultural fit and communication style

If you share the details above I’ll prepare a short, ranked shortlist (3–6 agencies) tailored to your needs with reasons, likely costs, and questions to ask each one. Want me to do that?
